description: Enable the existing Run proactive review control. One click must enqueue one proposal-only proactive review through Oban and must not change any write setting. Disable the control while a matching job is queued or running. Show queued, running, completed, skipped, and failed feedback, then refresh the dashboard data. Acceptance: repeated clicks cannot create duplicate concurrent jobs; the control reports an unavailable runtime; the job makes zero protocol effects even when live writes are configured elsewhere; LiveView and worker integration tests cover success, duplicate click, unavailable runtime, and failure.
title: Enable manual proactive review in the admin panel
